params.columns: k UInt8, a UInt8, b UInt8, c UInt8, d UInt8
params.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number AS k, k * 3 AS a, k % 7 AS b, 255 - k AS c, k % 2 AS d FROM numbers({rows})

description: One INSERT of 100 rows into a table of 5 UInt8 columns: every small part file rides inline in the manifest; only the files the source forces to blobs are uploaded.
